adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation in `handleAdd`, but it is only reset to `false` in the Cancel button handler. The dialog close path `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` (ESC / X) does not reset `isInvalidEmail`, and the mutation `onSuccess` resets `multiEmailValue` and closes the dialog but also does not reset `isInvalidEmail`. Since the dialog component stays mounted (rendered unconditionally in BookingListItem), the error state can persist across close/reopen, matching the finding.
